images.filename: Five California Gulls, a flock of Heermann's Gulls, and Sanderlings fly above Limantour Beach, Marin Co, California (21514993-146b-4ab1-801f-7bcadd8a3b8e).jpg
images.caption:
Five medium-sized gulls with light gray backs and yellow bills with black rings near the tips stand in the foreground on a beach. Beyond, are dozens of slightly smaller gulls that have gray bodies, dark gray backs, dark legs and feet, and red bills with black tips. In the background, dozens of light-colored sandpipers fly low over crashing waves.
Five California Gulls on the edge of a flock of Heermann's gulls while sandpipers fly above the surf in the background at Limantour Beach.
*Subject: Five California gulls (Larus californicus) on the edge of a flock of Heermann's Gulls (Larus heermanni) while Sanderlings (Calidris alba) fly above the surf in the background at Limantour Beach. October 9, 2022.
